message.content:
A medium‑sized apple (about 182 g) typically contains around **95 calories**.  
If you’re looking at a range:

| Size | Approximate Calories |
|------|----------------------|
| Small (≈150 g) | ~80–85 |
| Medium (≈182 g) | ~95 |
| Large (≈223 g) | ~115–120 |

These values assume a standard red or green apple; varieties can differ slightly, but the calorie count stays within roughly 80–120 for most common apples.

We can answer with typical values: about 95 calories per medium apple (~182g). But we might want to mention that it depends on size. Provide approximate range: 80-120 calories. Also mention that it's low in fat, high in fiber, vitamin C. So answer accordingly. No tool needed.
